text: Bansko Bulgaria. Price: $450. A popular ski resort in the Pirin Mountains of Bulgaria, offering great winter sports and cultural heritage. Peak season (Jan–Feb): $650. Not available May–Oct.

Madonna di Campiglio Italy. Price: $1000. Skiing in the breathtaking views of the Dolomites.
St. Moritz Switzerland. Price: $1650. A luxurious ski vacation in an exclusive atmosphere in the Alps.
Tromsø Norway. Price: $950. A breathtaking Arctic city in Norway, famous for its stunning fjords and as a premier destination for viewing the Northern Lights.

London England. Price: $1600. Experience the timeless elegance of London: a perfect blend of royal heritage and modern sophistication.
New York USA. Price: $1400. New York City: the vibrant heart of the world, where iconic skylines meet endless energy and architectural wonder.

Rome Italy. Price: $725. An eternal city where ancient majesty meets timeless culture in every breathtaking street. Peak season (Apr–May, Sep–Oct): $1800–$1850, summer: $1500.
Vienna Austria. Price: $600. A majestic capital of imperial grandeur, world-class music, and refined architectural beauty. Peak season (Jun–Aug): $1100, December: $1400.

Plitvice Lakes Croatia. Price: $450. A breathtaking paradise of cascading waterfalls, crystal-clear turquoise lakes, and lush emerald forests. Peak season (Jun–Aug): $850–$950.

Maldives. Price: $1450. A pristine paradise of crystalline turquoise waters, vibrant coral reefs, and serene white-sand islands.
